sql_templates.template: SELECT h.symbol, s.company_name, s.sector, s.trading_signal FROM portfolio.holdings AS h JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS s ON h.symbol = s.symbol WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) LIMIT 50

title: Incremental Portfolio Add and Trim Analysis

python_tools.code:
def run(context):
    snapshots = context['scores.stage_snapshots']
    holdings = context['portfolio.holdings']
    latest_date = snapshots['snapshot_date'].max()
    latest_snapshots = snapshots[snapshots['snapshot_date'] == latest_date]
    merged = holdings.merge(latest_snapshots, on='symbol', how='inner')
    add_candidates = merged[(merged['stage'] == 'STAGE_2') & (merged['trading_signal'].isin(['BUY', 'STRONG_BUY']))]
    trim_candidates = merged[merged['trading_signal'] == 'SELL']
    return {'add_candidates': add_candidates, 'trim_candidates': trim_candidates}

validation_rules: Ensure symbols are present in latest stage snapshots.
Validate trading_signals align with expected actions.
